evidence.E1: Prior OCC version, test-window coverage from 2019-10-08 through 2019-10-08. The applicable dollar threshold is $250,000.
evidence.E2: Scope summary: the case concerns a new loan from an OCC-regulated lender, secured by one residential property with one to four units. For a loan, use the principal as the transaction value.
evidence.E3: Common comparison in both versions of the amount exception: the transaction qualifies under the amount test when its transaction value is at or below the applicable threshold.
evidence.E4: Amended OCC version, test-window coverage from 2019-10-09 through 2019-10-09. The applicable dollar threshold is $400,000.
